quote: Two Konecranes E-ACE 7/8 ECC 90 electric empty container handlers will operate across Transtec World’s container depot at the Port of Santos in Brazil, marking the first deployment of Konecranes electric empty container handlers in the Americas. The order was placed In Q4 2025, with delivery planned during Q2 2026.
note: Opened Konecranes English company primary 2026-10-04; 2× E-ACE / Santos / Americas-first confirmed; CapEx undisclosed.
